items.summary: 12 NOV 2026 11:48AM by PIB Delhi From Portability to Inclusion: Transforming Foodgrain Access The One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) scheme was launched in 2019 by the Department of Food & Public Distribution. It is a major reform of the Public Distribution System (PDS) , enabling nationwide portability of ration cards and beneficiaries covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).

facts.text: 12 NOV 2026 11:48AM by PIB Delhi From Portability to Inclusion: Transforming Foodgrain Access The One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) scheme was launched in 2019 by the Department of Food & Public Distribution.
ONORC facilitates approximately 3.27 crore portability transactions every month .
Since its inception, it has recorded over 233 crore inter-state and intra-state portability transactions , distributing more than 614 LMT of foodgrains .

100% Digitisation: Ration card and beneficiary databases are 100% digitised across all States/UTs as of October 2026 , covering around 78.65 crore beneficiaries, and are accessible on public transparency portals of States/UTs.

items.title: TDB-DST signs agreement with Astrome for ₹64.05 crore RDI support to develop sovereign space-based AI-ELINT constellation
items.summary: The project, with a total project cost of ₹128.11 crore, aims to develop a sovereign space-based Artificial Intelligence-enabled Electronic Intelligence (AI-ELINT) constellation for national security applications. The programme seeks to advance critical technologies from Technology Readiness Level (TRL)-4 to TRL-9, with financial support being provided through Optionally Convertible Debt (OCD).

facts.text: The project, with a total project cost of ₹128.11 crore, aims to develop a sovereign space-based Artificial Intelligence-enabled Electronic Intelligence (AI-ELINT) constellation for national security applications.
Astrome's project seeks to address this emerging technology requirement through the development of an integrated AI-ELINT satellite constellation.
The programme brings together three key technology components: an Electronic Intelligence (ELINT) payload, AI-based ground processing software, and inter-satellite communication links.
Complementing the satellite hardware, the AI-based ground processing software is designed to enable the efficient processing and analysis of information generated by the constellation.
